pages.title: LLM01:2025 Prompt Injection
pages.text:
Invented test text. A prompt injection happens when a user input or an external content changes the behaviour of a model in a way its developer did not intend.
Mitigations named here include constraining the model's behaviour, checking its outputs, granting the least privilege and asking a human before risky actions.

pages.text:
Invented test text. Excessive agency lets a model take harmful actions because it holds too many tools, too broad permissions or too much autonomy.
The page advises keeping only the extensions a task needs and requiring a human approval for high-impact actions.

The page advises treating the model like any user: validate its output and encode it for its context before display.
